auth.noneNote: No authorization information is sent with this request.
auth.digestNote: The request is first sent without credentials; if the server replies 401 with a Digest challenge, the response is computed and the request is sent once more. MD5 and SHA-256 are supported.
auth.publicClientHint: Leave empty for a public client
auth.desktopNote: Sign-in opens in the system browser and returns to {callback}. The provider must have {loopback} (loopback, any port) registered as the redirect address.
auth.awsNote: The request is signed with Signature v4, including its body, right before it is sent.
auth.headersNote: If you write a header with the same name in the Headers tab, the value you typed is used.
